capabilities: Apply Mica, Mica Alt or Acrylic window materials
Extend materials to pop-out notes and standalone settings windows
Read the 7-shade Windows 11 accent palette from the registry
Map accent shades to WinUI 3 light and dark contrast rules
Refresh on window focus, on a polling interval, or by command
disambiguation: Not a theme; it applies native window materials and system accent colors for use alongside the Fluent 2 theme.
extras: Windows-only; stays inactive on macOS and Linux. Known limitation: CSS backdrop-filter blur stops rendering while native Mica or Acrylic is active, so menus and popovers fall back to a near-opaque surface. Reads accent colors with read-only reg.exe queries and makes no network requests.
motivation: Built as the official companion plugin for the Fluent 2 theme.
problem: Obsidian on Windows 11 does not use the native window backdrop materials, and its renderer falls back to a default blue instead of the user's system accent color.

relations.evidence: Designed for the Fluent 2 theme and compatible with any translucent-ready theme.

summary: Windows 11 companion that applies native Mica, Mica Alt or Acrylic window materials and syncs the system 7-shade accent palette to the Fluent 2 theme.
